data.content_ref: inline:The admissible enrichment in SRC_004 and the covering principle in SRC_009 share a shared mechanism: both are polynomial-time, monotone edge-construction functions applied before the standard grounded fixpoint, differing only in whether the enrichment is bounded by an explicit covering quantifier. Refuted if SRC_009 admits an enrichment that is not an instance of SRC_004's admissible class, or if SRC_004's class contains a function SRC_009's covering principle cannot express.
